notes: attempt-1 was exploratory (variable labels, country/type counts, non-missing outcome counts; no RESULT lines). Final run: airframe_data.dta restricted to fighters and bombers; continuous two-piece linear spline in year with knot at 1926 (pre = min(year-1926,0), post = max(year-1926,0)); OLS with HC1 robust SEs via fixest. Table 1 cols 1-2: US only, log wing load / log max speed on spline + constant (N=116 / 174). Cols 3-4: pooled US+UK, common spline (the UK spline) + US indicator + US x spline pieces; the US x spline coefficients are the relative slopes (N=165 / 233). Table 4 col 1: engine_data.dta, US engines, log hp per lb on spline + liquid-cooled indicator + constant (N=85). All 12 quantities matched the paper at reported precision on the first scored run, so no claim-driven changes were made. No script files from the dataset were opened. Timestamps taken from the host clock.
